chapter.verse: Tu-in Judea gam ah Festus a tun zawh ni thum ciangin Caesarea pan Jerusalem ah paito hi.
Siampi liante leh Jew mithupite in Festus' kiangah Paul a khiat ban uhah thum uh a,
Jerusalem ah Paul a sap nading hehpihna ngen uh hi. A hang pen lamkal ah Paul galguk panna tawh thah sawm uh ahih man hi.
Festus in Paul pen Caesarea ah galkapte cinna tawh om cih thu leh amahmah zong pai baih a sawmna thu gen a,
“Tua ahih manin note' lakpan milian maitang neite kei hong zuisak unla, hua mipa tawh kisai khialhna khatpeuh a om leh amah khia-in thu bawl uh hen,” ci hi.
Tua mite' lakah Festus ni giat hiam, ni sawm hiam, tua val kan taam lo-in Caesarea ah paisuk hi. A zingciangin thukhenna tokhom ah tu-in Paul a kipaipih dingin thupia hi.
Paul a tun ciangin Jerusalem pana hong paisuk Jew mite zong ama' kimkot ah ding uh a, teci lak theilo pi-in Paul mawhsakna thu a lianpipi tampitak sung uh hi.
Paul in mawhloh lahtelna thu gen a, “Jew mite' thukhun ahi-a biakinnpi ahi-a Caesar ahi zongin langpangin khialhna ka bawl kei hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Festus in Jew mite maipha pia nuam ahih manin Paul' kiangah, “Hih thute ah keima' thukhenna a sang dingin Jerusalem nong paito nuam hiam?” ci hi.
Paul in, “Kei pen thukhenna ka san nadinga kilawm mun, Caesar' thukhenna tokhom mai-ah a ding ka hi hi. Teltak na theih mah bangin Jew mite' tungah khialhna bangmah ka bawl kei hi.

A zenzenin kei khialhna bawlpa hi-in sihna tawh kituak thu khatpeuh a bawl ka hihleh sihna ka pelh sawm kei ding hi. Ahih hangin amaute' hong mawhsakna bangmahlo ahihleh kuamah in amau' khutsung hong ap theih nading thu om lo hi. Caesar' kiangah thumbeh theih ding hehpih ka ngen hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Festus in ama' ulianpawl tawh a kikup khit ciangin dawnna pia a, “Caesar' kiangah thumbeh theihna na ngen khinta hi. Caesar' kiangah na pai kul ding hi,” ci hi.
Ni tampi khit ciangin Caesarea ah Kumpi Agrippa leh Bernice hong tungin Festus' kiangah kihil uh hi.
Tua takah sauveipi taam uh ahih manin Festus in kumpipa' kiangah hih bangin Paul' thu ko hi: “Felix' hong nusiat thongkia mi khat om a,
Jerusalem ka om laitak siampi liante leh Jew makaite in amah thu bawlin ama' tungah mawhsak thukhenna neih ding hong ngen uh hi.

Ngawh a thuak mi khatpeuh, amah a ngawhte tawh maitang kimu-in tua ngawhna thu tawh kisai-in mawhloh lahtelna thu gen theihna hunpha khat a kihon masiah amah mawhsak ding pen Rome mite' ngeina hilo, ci-in amaute ka dawng hi.
Tua hangin amaute hih takah hong pai uh ciangin zia-ol lo-in a zingciangin thukhenna tokhom ah ka tu pah a, tua mipa hong kipaipih nadingin thupiak ka bawl hi.
A mawhsakte hong din ciangin thusia ka upmawhte tawh ngawh lo uh hi.
Amau' kinial thu pen amau' biaklepaai vai peuh, Jesu a kici a si khin khat Paul in nungta hi a cih teitei vai peuh, hi lel hi.
Tua thute kankhiatzia ding ngaihsun theilo ka hih manin tua vai Jerusalem ah thukhenna a sang dingin hong pai nuam ding hiam cih Paul ka dong hi.
Ahih hangin Paul in gambup kumpipa' khensatna ngak nuamin galkap cinna tawh a kikep nading hong thumbeh ciangin Caesar' kiangah ka puak theih mateng galkap cinna tawh kep dingin thupiak ka nei hi.”
Festus' thugen a man ciangin Agrippa in, “Keimahmah in tua mipa' thugen ka ngai nuam hi,” ci hi. Festus in, “Zingciang a thugen na ngai kha ding hi,” ci hi.

A zingciangin Agrippa leh Bernice kizem kithawi-in hong pikuan mahmah uh a, galkap tul-uk mangte leh khuasung mithupite tawh kikhopna innpi sung lut uh hi. Festus' thupiakna tawh Paul zong innpi sung kitumpih hi.

Tua ciangin Festus in hih bangin ci hi: “Kumpi Agrippa leh hih taka omte khempeuh aw, hih na muh uh mipa pen Jerusalem hitaleh, hih takah hitaleh, Jew mipi bup awngin amah hingkhawihuai lo ci-in kei' kianga hong khiat uh mipa ahi hi.
Himah taleh sihna a thuaktaak thu bangmah ka mu kei hi. Tua banah amahmah in gambup kumpipa' kiangah thumbehna a puaktohnop ciangin ama' cih bang mangin paisak dingin ka khensat hi.

Ahi zongin ka topa' tungah ama' vai gelhkhiat ding thu kician ka nei kei hi. Tua hangin i vekin thu i dottel khit ciangin gelhkhiat ding khatpeuh ngah thei ding ka hih manin no teng khempeuh' mai leh a diakin Kumpi Agrippa aw, nangma' mai-ah amah kong paipih hi.
A hang pen thongkia mi khat kumpipa' kiangah puak napi-in amah a kingawhna thu teng laktel lo ding cih pen thulam tawn ka sa kei hi.”Kumpi Agrippa' mai-ah Paul
